column2: Heavy riveted armour plate. Large bold steel panels divided by deep dark seams, with thick round rivets in rows along every seam casting hard-edged dark recesses. Cold blue-grey steel, near-black in the seams and gouges, bright at the panel crowns. Very high contrast between panel face and seam — the plate geometry must still read when shrunk tiny.

Dark volcanic stone shot through with a branching network of molten gold-amber veins that glow from within. The stone is near-black basalt with a matte crackled surface; the veins are thick, confident, high-contrast, branching like lightning across the whole square. Arcane and heavy.

Pure black surface with a glowing acid-green wireframe grid receding in perspective, plus scattered brighter green data-glyph blocks and horizontal scanline streaks. High contrast, almost no mid-tones — black and neon green only. Reads as raw cyberspace.

Scratched, pitted chrome that has lived hard. Mirror-bright in patches, dulled and hazed in others, with rust blooms at the edges, dried grime in the low spots and a few deep gouges. Cold steel and warm rust together.

Matte black polymer casing with inset copper circuit traces and small amber indicator LEDs glowing warm along the paths. Traces run in clean orthogonal runs with right-angle turns, like a densely packed circuit board. Black, copper and amber only.

Deep black wet asphalt with a bright, high-contrast crimson spatter across it. The blood is vivid and saturated, in a few big confident pools and streaks rather than fine droplets, with sharp bright specular highlights where it catches light. Background is almost pure black. Extreme contrast — vivid red and black only, no brown mud, no muted midtones.
